paper.title: Reasoning-State Expression and Critical Failure Modules in LLM Agents: A Multivariate Analysis of AgentErrorBench

confirmatory.name: mean_memory_length
confirmatory.definition: Mean token count of <memory> tag content per trajectory, averaged across steps where <memory> is present

confirmatory.name: memory_proportion
confirmatory.definition: Sum of <memory> tokens / sum of (memory + reflection + plan) tokens per trajectory

confirmatory.name: memory_variability
confirmatory.definition: Variance of <memory> token counts across steps where <memory> is present

confirmatory.name: mean_reflection_length
confirmatory.definition: Mean token count of <reflection> tag content per trajectory, averaged across steps where <reflection> is present

confirmatory.name: reflection_proportion
confirmatory.definition: Sum of <reflection> tokens / sum of (memory + reflection + plan) tokens per trajectory

confirmatory.name: reflection_variability
confirmatory.definition: Variance of <reflection> token counts across steps where <reflection> is present

exploratory_only.name: mean_plan_length
exploratory_only.definition: Mean token count of <plan> tag content per trajectory
exploratory_only.note: Exploratory only — proximity to Planning/Inefficient-Plan labels

exploratory_only.name: plan_proportion
exploratory_only.definition: Sum of <plan> tokens / sum of (memory + reflection + plan) tokens per trajectory

exploratory_only.name: plan_variability
exploratory_only.definition: Variance of <plan> token counts across steps where <plan> is present

removed.name: mean_think_length
removed.reason: Construct validity failure: <think> presence is model-determined (0%/0%/40%/100% across model identities)

removed.name: reasoning_to_action_ratio
removed.reason: Lost conceptual anchor after Reasoning Expression construct was removed

vif.note: VIF values 118-166 identified but diagnosed as wrong tool for distance-based non-coefficient-estimating PERMANOVA
vif.verdict: Not a design failure; documented as Step 6 limitation

redundancy.verdict: Qualified limitation — redundancy does not alter primary conclusion

memory_growth_audit.verdict: Model-specific nuisance; association strengthens after model adjustment

model_confounding.verdict: Substantial nuisance; association survives model adjustment

rq1.predictor_set: 6 confirmatory (Memory Expression x3, Reflection Expression x3)

permdisp.verdict: Passes assumption check (p > 0.05, though close to threshold)

rq2.action_module_note: Action module shows clearest separation from other modules across multiple predictors

dunn_key_findings.mean_plan_length: action vs plan p=0.0275, action vs reflection p=0.0180, action vs system p=0.0229, memory vs plan p=0.0139
dunn_key_findings.mean_reflection_length: memory vs plan p=0.0013, memory vs reflection p=0.0132
dunn_key_findings.mean_memory_length: action vs plan p=0.0237, action vs reflection p=0.0037, action vs system p=0.0048

rq3.test: Factorial PERMANOVA — interaction term (Module x Environment)
rq3.note: Environment R2=0.0000 expected — within-environment z-scoring removes environment variance from distance matrix by construction

sensitivity.reason: GAIA-only sensitivity analysis did not reproduce the primary association; all other pre-specified sensitivity analyses preserved the qualitative conclusion

final_outcome.reason: The GAIA-only sensitivity analysis did not reproduce the primary association, whereas all other pre-specified sensitivity analyses preserved the qualitative conclusion
final_outcome.rq1_statement: RQ1 demonstrates a statistically significant multivariate association between the confirmatory Reasoning-State Expression profile (Memory and Reflection Expression) and critical failure module (PERMANOVA pseudo-F=3.207, R2=0.0835, blocked-permutation p=0.0001)

threats_to_validity.evidence: 49 plan vs 29 planning labels, strongly correlated with environment

threats_to_validity.mitigation: Supplementary model-adjustment diagnostic; association survives (pseudo-F 4.21 to 2.73, p=0.005)

threats_to_validity.evidence: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo shows cumulative memory growth (median slope 4.38 vs 0.11-0.13 for others)
threats_to_validity.mitigation: Module association strengthens after model adjustment (pseudo-F 3.83 to 5.14, p=0.001 to 0.007)

threats_to_validity.evidence: Mantel r=0.83-0.90 between full and reduced profiles
threats_to_validity.mitigation: PERMANOVA conclusion invariant across alternative predictor subsets
